title: Return a typed list
summary: FastAPI: Return a typed list. Add another book.
introduction: A list response can contain several small data objects. Open GET /books.
learningObjectives: Return a typed list with FastAPI

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Return a typed list

blocks.text: The response model checks each Book item and serialises the list.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Every list item must fit the response model.
